item.title: Amazon, Nvidia Flood OpenAI With Cash as ChatGPT Maker’s Valuation Hits $730 Billion
item.description: OpenAI just secured $110 billion in fresh investment, and announced additional collaborations with two of the big backers.

item.title: Minnesota Weighs Total Ban on Bitcoin and Crypto ATMs
item.description: Minnesota lawmakers are considering a ban on Bitcoin and crypto ATMs, with legislation introduced in response to a growing number of scams.

item.title: Ban on Crypto Privacy Tools Would Be Counterproductive: UK Think Tank
item.description: UK officials at a recent roundtable by the Royal United Services Institute want to integrate compliance solutions into crypto privacy tools.

item.title: Ethereum Tokens Swiped, Returned After South Korean Tax Service Publishes Wallet Seed Phrases
item.description: South Korea's tax service shared the seed phrases for seized wallets in a press release. The contents were then taken, but ultimately returned.

item.title: Trump Media Weighs Truth Social Spinoff Following Bitcoin, Crypto ETF Moves
item.description: Trump Media is considering spinning off its Truth Social platform into its own public entity.

item.title: Magic Eden Pulls Plug on Bitcoin and Ethereum Support, Doubles Down on Solana
item.description: Magic Eden is pulling support for Ethereum-compatible and Bitcoin-based assets, marking an end to its multi-chain approach to user adoption.

item.title: Bitcoin Rebound Stalls at $65K as Stocks Fall and Gold Rises
item.description: Bitcoin fell Friday after briefly topping $69K this week, while stocks like CoreWeave and BitMine tumbled amid broader market losses.

item.title: Anthropic 'Retires' Claude Opus 3—Then Gives It a Blog to Reflect on Its Existence
item.description: The AI’s Substack lands amid growing questions about identity, sentience, and how models are retired.

item.title: Banking Giant Barclays Mulls Crypto Payments Push: Bloomberg
item.description: Publicly traded banking giant Barclays is considering making a push into crypto payments and deposits, according to a report from Bloomberg.

item.title: Trump Orders Federal Agencies to Dump 'Woke' Anthropic AI After Pentagon Dispute
item.description: President Trump gave government agencies six months to phase out Anthropic's products after a clash over military safeguards.
